sources.title: Rebuilding Among AIs from Six Log Files - AI Storm
sources.snippet: Developer DedeProGames reverse-engineered a social-deduction game's engine and 59×34 map from six log files to build a benchmark for evaluating language models' reasoning and deception abilities. The project ran 90 games across six models in the 27-31 billion parameter range, separating each model's private reasoning from its public output.
